description:
## Problem
tests/unit/core/load_testing/test_executor.py::TestConcurrentLoadExecutorEdgeCases::test_high_concurrency runs SteadyPattern(concurrency=20, duration_seconds=0.5) and asserts max_concurrency_reached > 0. On a busy runner no stream started before the pattern ended: trunk run 45188452490 (develop 5e784d6039, medium-test shard 0) failed with max_concurrency_reached == 0. The six earlier trunk runs passed, and the merged change did not touch load testing. The failed job was re-run once on owner instruction.

## Change
Make the assertion independent of scheduler timing: for example, wait until streams start or check the outcome the test means to pin, rather than a race against a 0.5 s window.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the test passes 200 consecutive runs under pytest-xdist with CPU contention (or an equivalent deterministic proof), and still fails when the executor starts no streams.
